title: Inter can't name the same eleven at Bologna — what the papers expect from Chivu
description:
Inter cannot name the same eleven at Bologna.
https://www.nerazzurridaily.com/go/yt/?ed=44

Blue means the club said it. Pink means only the papers did.

CONFIRMED — Champions League, matchday 2 at San Siro: Inter 3–4 Club Brugge. Lautaro 44' and 81', Bonny 90+3'. No points from two, 28th of 36 in the league phase.
REPORTED — Gazzetta dello Sport and Corriere dello Sport, via FCInterNews, Oct 15: Bisseck, Çalhanoğlu and Thuram all started against both Parma and Club Brugge and could sit; Carlos Augusto and Pavard are in line to start.
CONFIRMED — Inter.it and Lega Serie A, Oct 14: Chivu's press conference is Friday at 8:30 AM ET, 14:30 CEST, and Daniele Doveri will referee at Bologna.

Next up: Bologna away, Saturday, October 17 — 12:00 PM ET, 18:00 CEST. US TV: Paramount+, CBS Sports Golazo, Peacock.
